scope: Read-only analysis of existing observations and fixed eligible cohort; original results are preserved.

shared_source_locators_reviewed.interpretation: Distinct measurements: different assay descriptions and values. Both retained.

IC50_comparison.method: Hold the original ten eligible compounds, non-target criterion scores, equal weights and 50% coverage threshold fixed. Recompute each target median using only IC50/pIC50 observations and renormalize target scores among available values. Missing IC50 target summaries remain missing; no replacement or imputation.

remaining_source_uncertainty: Distinct database records can refer to the same underlying experiment; exact cross-database experimental identity is unresolved where original references and assay conditions were not retained. Matching numerical values alone were not used to delete records.
